{"task": {"id": "I_kwDONElfw88AAAABYj8VrQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlV6PzhCIyMg", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlV6P", "number": 92, "title": "Unify PMD and PMX physics behavior unless a format-specific difference is justified", "body": "## Problem

The maintainer's policy is: **PMD and PMX must use the same physics processing unless a concrete, format-specific reason requires different behavior.** Historical implementation choices or mere backward compatibility with a possibly problematic code path are not, on their own, enough reason to diverge.

A confirmed unjustified-or-at-least-unproven divergence exists in [`src/animation/MMDPhysics.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/animation/MMDPhysics.ts):
- `skeletalPositionOnly = metadata?.format === 'pmx' && params.type === 2`.
- PMX Type-2 rigid bodies merge authored skeletal translation with Bullet rotation **on the bone only**, leaving Bullet's native dynamic transform untouched (corrected in [#53 / PR #54](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/54), with a real-Bullet joint/contact reproducer).
- PMD Type-2 bodies still use the **legacy native COM position writeback** in `updateBone()/_setPositionFromBone()`. This also affects deferred Type-2 paths and [Worker Physics](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/animation/PhysicsWorkerRuntime.ts). No compelling PMD-specific physics requirement has been established for that writeback.

The maintainer currently observes severe physics breakage in **PMD**, while equivalent breakage in PMX is **not confirmed**. This observation motivates the audit but **is not proof that Type-2 alignment is the cause**.

Other format-dependent branches may exist in the physics input, simulation, reset, warmup, output and loader normalization paths. Review these too rather than leaving arbitrary PMD/PMX exceptions.

## Expected outcome

**Adopt a unified PMD/PMX physics policy**, using the existing PMX Type-2 correction for PMD as well **unless a specific, evidence-backed difference requires otherwise**. In normal physical Type-2 operation, bone translation stays skeletal, bone rotation follows Bullet, and **native dynamic rigid-body position is not teleported after a physics step**. Apply the chosen invariant consistently across standalone/shared Sync, Worker, reset/warmup and deferred input paths.

**Audit other PMD-versus-PMX branches in the physics pipeline** and either:
1. remove differences that cannot be justified, or
2. retain and document each necessary format-specific difference with the actual reason and tests.

Distinguish *input-file representation/normalization* (for example, PMX and PMD storing rigid-body position offsets differently), *format-specific features* (for example PMX before/after-physics bones), and real behavioral requirements from arbitrary duplicated or legacy physics policies. **Do not mechanically delete legitimate format handling or disable PMX-only functionality.**

This is a direct behavior change, not a comparison-only feature flag or a new physics parameter experiment. The maintainer will visually assess real-model physics later; **visual improvement and resolution of intermittent breakage are NOT acceptance criteria**.

### Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Inventory **every PMD/PMX format-dependent branch relevant to physics** across loading/normalization, rigid-body modes, bone/body synchronization, joints, contact/constraints, zero-delta evaluation, reset/warmup, shared Sync and Worker. Provide a concise table of the observed difference, classification (required file-format semantics, genuine feature support, or legacy/unjustified behavior), proposed disposition, and evidence for any difference retained. Do not expand this task into unrelated material/rendering systems.
- [ ] **Remove the legacy PMD Type-2 native-body position realignment** unless an independently grounded PMD-specific requirement is demonstrated. Reuse the PMX skeleton-only Type-2 policy, including all regular and deferred/Worker paths; avoid leaving a PMD-only write through a different branch. Preserve Type-0 kinematic following, Type-1 dynamic authority, and correct Type-2 bone position/rotation.
- [ ] Unify other **unjustified behavioral differences** discovered by the audit. Where a difference is legitimately required (file metadata, PMX pre/post-physics animation, distinct format capabilities), document the exact reason and retain it. Do not presume that all PMD and PMX input data use identical raw coordinates.
- [ ] Test matching physical fixtures in **both PMD and PMX** with the same *normalized* rigid bodies, modes, motion, joint/contact conditions and elapsed-time tapes; assert the shared invariant and comparable native-body trajectories when the model semantics are equivalent. Include a constrained Type-2 body with a moving bone and collisions, 60/120 FPS sequences, PMX before/after-physics cases where meaningful, and Type-0/Type-1 regression cases.
- [ ] Cover standalone and shared Sync, Worker (transferable/shared where supported), reset, warmup, zero/positive delta, loop/seek, and Worker fallback. Update tests explicitly asserting historical PMD Type-2 teleports (e.g. `tests/type2-physics.test.ts`) to match justified behavior, using independent real-Bullet/kinematic oracles rather than merely copying implementation outcomes.
- [ ] Keep the current Bullet-backed Ammo WASM version, `unitStep=1/60`, maximum substeps, solver/ERP, damping, gravity, collision groups/masks, spring settings and published API contracts unchanged, other than necessary PMD/PMX physics unification. Document scope and a straightforward rollback.
- [ ] Run relevant typecheck, unit/real-Bullet integration, browser/Worker checks, library/Examples builds, and locally served Examples smoke checks before merge. Record actual results and limitations. **Do not add a success criterion that the intermittent PMD violent motion stops, visually improves, or is confirmed fixed.**

### Required post-merge verification

- **PENDING until performed:** Inspect the **latest attempt** of the merge-triggered GitHub Pages workflow. Verify successful publishing of the merge SHA and the generated JS/WASM/Examples artifacts, including paths and version evidence. This is a **post-merge check**, not a pre-merge approval requirement.
- **PENDING until performed:** Basic public-browser smoke-check of PMD, PMX/Gene Light and Worker Physics Examples for successful WASM initialization, model loading and playback without new runtime errors. Record actual URLs, browser and evidence; no model-quality/stability assertion is required.
- **Optional maintainer follow-up; never a merge blocker:** The maintainer will later visually inspect actual PMD models at 60/120 FPS. Treat any observed change in physics breakage as **UNVERIFIED** until reported, and do not claim it as part of acceptance or CI success.

## Context

- [MMDPhysics Type-2 decision and update paths](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/animation/MMDPhysics.ts), [Worker](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/animation/PhysicsWorkerRuntime.ts), [Loader normalization](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/loaders/MMDLoader.ts), [PMX phase handling](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/animation/PMXPoseLayers.ts).
- [#53](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/53) / [PR #54](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/54) and [type-2 validation](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/docs/type2-physics-validation.md) demonstrate PMX native teleport damage, explicitly leaving PMD on the old compatibility path.
- Independent physics references: [Saba](https://github.com/benikabocha/saba/blob/master/src/Saba/Model/MMD/MMDPhysics.cpp) and [babylon-mmd](https://github.com/noname0310/babylon-mmd/blob/main/src/Runtime/Optimized/Physics/mmdBulletPhysics.ts).
- Current `main` when filing: `90eaf53b69969fefcc8fa59f6d1cd4be23e66d62`, including startup pose ramp [#90 / PR #91](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/pull/91).
